name: Brands Hatch GP Circuit
description: Kent's natural amphitheatre. The Grand Prix loop drops down Paddock Hill bend, climbs to Druids, then heads out into the woods past Hawthorn and Westfield.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (1295 of 1562 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
